definition.content:
Kueue is a Kubernetes-native job queueing system that admits batch, training, and AI workloads based on quotas and priorities across ClusterQueues, LocalQueues, ResourceFlavors, and Cohorts. This dashboard tracks admission, queue congestion, quota utilization, fairness, preemptions, and queue health.

**Useful links:**
- [Datadog Kueue Integration Documentation](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/kueue/)
- [Kueue Official Website](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/)
Key health and activity signals at a glance for quick detection of problems and drill-down into the relevant section.
ClusterQueue resource usage versus nominal quota per resource, plus cohort and ClusterQueue fairness through weighted share.
Workload admission and queue congestion: pending and admitted workloads, admission wait time, and per-ClusterQueue backlog.
Preemption and eviction activity by ClusterQueue and reason to detect thrashing and workload churn.
Status and health of ClusterQueues and LocalQueues, and workload completion signals to spot queues that cannot admit work.
Health of the Kueue controller manager: reconciliation throughput and errors, work queue depth, leader election, and process resource usage.
Kueue controller manager logs, with errors and critical events highlighted.

query.query_string: source:kueue status:(alert OR error OR critical)
